actions.label: RDR2 60FPS runtime patch
actions.firmwareEvidence: The author requires a jailbroken PS5 with elfldr, and discusses 8.40 or newer including 13.60, but does not publish a complete validated firmware list. An empty list means compatibility is unspecified, not universal.

loaderEvidence.acknowledgement: HTTP 200 is sent before the ELF is downloaded or spawned.

requirements: A jailbroken PS5 with elfldr v0.27 or another loader implementing its HTTP URL interface on port 9021. A configured local sender can alternatively use the compatible raw TCP loader route.
For native URL loading, the ready ELF must be published at a URL the console can reach. A computer-only 127.0.0.1 URL is not reachable from the PS5.
RDR2 PS4 game update 1.32, clean and unmodified, with title ID CUSA08519, CUSA03041 or CUSA08568.
Fully close RDR2, load this ELF first, wait for its ready notification, then start RDR2 within 10 minutes.
This applies a runtime FPS/resolution patch; it is not a full mod menu or a PS4 payload.
The author does not provide a complete validated PS5 firmware list. Check the release requirements for your existing loader and firmware.
The HTTP loader accepts the request before download and execution; HTTP 200 does not confirm the patch ran. Read the console notification and /data/rdr2-60fps/rdr2-60fps.log for the actual result.
actions.installation: The ready ELF is loaded in memory. Its first run creates /data/rdr2-60fps/scale.txt for optional resolution settings. Closing the game removes the runtime game changes.
actions.imageRole: Game artwork; not a screenshot of this runtime patch.
